faq: What do you need from me?
A list of your tools, the plan you are on and what it costs. Screenshots of billing pages are enough. We do not need logins, and you never share passwords.
Do you review tools that are not well known?
Yes, as long as they have public documentation. If we cannot find enough information, we say so in the table instead of guessing about a feature.
Will the review change my accounts?
No. It is a written review only. You decide what to switch on or cancel, and we can help with the setup later as a separate job.
Are your recommendations paid for by tool makers?
No. We are not a reseller for any of these tools and take no commission. The review is based on your needs, cost and the features listed publicly.
